name: kidsenglish-client
description: 战机英语客户端 monorepo 根（npm workspaces：engine 调度引擎 + app 应用壳）

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kidsenglish/engine && npm run build --workspace @kidsenglish/app
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npm run cap:sync --workspace @kidsenglish/app
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && npm run apk:debug --workspace @kidsenglish/app
